# genesyscloud_analytics_dataretention_settings (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud Analytics Maximum Interaction Data Retention Time. This is a singleton resource; only one instance exists per organization. Once the setting has been configured it cannot be cleared, only changed to another value. Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state and does not change the setting in Genesys Cloud.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/analytics/dataretention/settings](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-analytics-dataretention-settings)
* [PUT /api/v2/analytics/dataretention/settings](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#put-api-v2-analytics-dataretention-settings)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `analytics:dataRetention:edit`
* `analytics:dataRetention:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `analytics`
* `analytics:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_analytics_dataretention_settings" "example_analytics_dataretention_settings" {
  retention_days = 3650
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `retention_days` (Number) The maximum number of days that interaction data and recordings are retained for the organization. All interactions and recordings, including protected recordings, are deleted after this many days from their initial recording. The minimum value is determined by the organization's limits; the Genesys Cloud UI requires at least 90 days. The update is rejected if existing recording media retention policies, recordings or the snippet recording settings exceed the new value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
